package.name: robotops_trace_rclcpp_autoattach
package.description: Process-wide LD_PRELOAD auto-attach for stock rclcpp_action (ROB-453): interposes the non-templated ServerBase/ClientBase goal-UUID seams so STOCK Nav2 emits CLIENT + SERVER action spans keyed by robot.action.goal_id — the agent's TraceJoiner then stitches mission -> bt_navigator -> planner/controller into one connected trace, with no code changes and no fork.
